items.name: Carolina Beach Lifeguard Stand Embroidered Crewneck Sweatshirt
items.alt: White crewneck sweatshirt with a small embroidered lifeguard stand and the words Carolina Beach on the chest, worn on the sand, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A small lifeguard stand with a red flag and the town name Carolina Beach, embroidered on the chest of a white crewneck sweatshirt.
facts: 9.5 oz garment-dyed, 80% ring-spun cotton and 20% polyester
Lifeguard stand and town name stitched in navy and red thread, about 2.8 x 2.5 in
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low, do not iron the embroidery
